description: This file defines the CellAddress class, which manages cell address representations within a spreadsheet, including methods for constructing addresses, validating, and formatting with optional worksheet context.

classes.name: CellAddress
classes.description: Represents a cell address in a spreadsheet, with methods for address manipulation and retrieval, optionally including worksheet context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CellAddress object with a cell address string and optional worksheet.

methods.name: fullCellAddress
methods.description: Returns the full cell address, including worksheet name if available.

methods.name: worksheet
methods.description: Returns the associated Worksheet object, if any.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.description: Returns the cell address string without worksheet context.

methods.name: nextRow
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object offset by a specified number of rows downward.

methods.name: previousRow
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object offset by a specified number of rows upward.

methods.name: nextColumn
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object offset by a specified number of columns to the right.

methods.name: previousColumn
methods.description: Returns a new CellAddress object offset by a specified number of columns to the left.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cell address, including worksheet name if available.
